description: Defines PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) configuration structures, enums, constants, and formatters for a 5G/4G radio system implementation, including parameters for RLC modes, sequence number sizes, discard timers, and custom configurations.

classes.name: pdcp_metrics_notifier
classes.description: Forward declaration for a class responsible for notifying PDCP metrics.

methods.name: pcdp_sn_cardinality
methods.description: Calculates the total number of sequence numbers for a given SN size.

methods.name: pdcp_window_size
methods.description: Returns the PDCP window size based on sequence number size.

methods.name: pdcp_data_header_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the PDCP data header based on SN size.

methods.name: pdcp_data_trailer_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the PDCP data trailer based on RB type and integrity setting.

methods.name: pdcp_discard_timer_from_int
methods.description: Converts an integer to a PDCP discard timer enum value if valid.

methods.name: pdcp_discard_timer_to_int
methods.description: Converts a PDCP discard timer enum to its integer representation.

methods.name: pdcp_make_default_srb_config
methods.description: Creates a default configuration for SRB (Signaling Radio Bearer) PDCP.
